'''1997 Tatooine Regionals (Salt Lake City)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], one of three in the Tatooine region (New Mexico, Arizona, Nevada, Utah, Colorado).<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Tatooine)
* '''Date:''' 30 August 1997
* '''Site:''' Mark Enterprizes, Salt Lake City, Utah
